headline: YouTube says it isn’t testing hiding the dislike button
summary: YouTube denies claims of testing a feature to hide the dislike button. Reports on X, based on user screenshots, were inaccurate. A spokesperson confirmed no such test is currently active.

headline: Tesla says customers can add their own vehicles to the robotaxi fleet next year — will it happen?
summary: Tesla aims to allow owners to add their vehicles to its robotaxi fleet by 2025. This promise was made during the Q3 earnings call by VP Ashok Elluswamy. It follows years of similar, unfulfilled pledges from Elon Musk.

headline: Data centers could erase decades of air quality gains
summary: A surge in new data centers, fueled by AI demand, threatens to reverse air quality improvements. Texas, a hub for AI infrastructure, is projected to see pollution levels return to 2000s levels. Increased electricity demand for these centers could lead to higher emissions.

headline: Meta to create a new class of shares to fund AI push
summary: Meta plans to issue a new class of non-voting shares. These shares will fund AI initiatives, potential acquisitions, and employee compensation. Trading for the new stock is slated to begin in 2027.

headline: Amazon Is Selling Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration ETBs Below Market Rate — if You Can Secure an Invite
summary: Amazon is offering Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration Elite Trainer Boxes at a 50% discount. The ETBs are priced at $59.99, significantly below the current market rate. Customers must request an invite to purchase the discounted boxes.

headline: 'We Were Working on a Great Game' — Former Mass Effect 5 Writers Speak Out After EA Shuts Down BioWare
summary: Former Mass Effect 5 writers lament the cancellation of their project after BioWare's shutdown. EA has closed the beloved 30-year-old studio. Writers shared their disappointment and details about the unreleased game.

headline: Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3 Narrows Release Window Following Player Feedback
summary: Bandai Namco has narrowed the release window for Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3. The multiplayer brawler is now expected in the second half of 2027. This update follows player feedback on the previously broader 2027 announcement.

headline: Brandon Sanderson Wants to Know Who Really Wrote the Mr. Beast Book
summary: Renowned author Brandon Sanderson is investigating the true authorship of Mr. Beast's book. He questions who genuinely wrote the influencer's recent publication. The inquiry hints at potential ghostwriting concerns.

headline: What is PHP and why did it spark an international cyber-security alert?
summary: AI has uncovered critical, long-standing programming flaws in PHP. This discovery triggered a rare international cybersecurity alert. The vulnerabilities posed significant risks to global web infrastructure.

headline: Barclays cutting 5,000 jobs as it increases reliance on AI
summary: Barclays is slashing 5,000 jobs as part of a major restructuring effort. The bank attributes the workforce reduction to its increasing reliance on AI technologies. This move represents a 5% cut in the company's total workforce.

headline: Rosenberg: Russia agrees to Ukraine talks but sees little to talk about in new peace push
summary: Russia has consented to new peace talks regarding Ukraine. However, Moscow reportedly perceives little substance in the latest peace proposals. President Putin feels no current pressure to end the ongoing conflict.

headline: Diabetes and ADHD drugs to be tested on Alzheimer's patients in new study
summary: A new study will investigate the efficacy of diabetes and ADHD drugs for Alzheimer's treatment. The research aims to test these drugs simultaneously to accelerate discovery. Scientists hope to find faster and more effective treatments for dementia.
